title: What stangent-finding-disprover returns with security-flag on (D148)
description: The same verdict as finding-disprover-output, and whether the finding touches security. A flag cites a code line, which code checks as it does the verdict's quote. A stands verdict has to give suggestedSeverity; code checks that too.

verdict.description: refuted: a code line shows the app does what the FSD says. stands: code shows the difference, on a path that's reached. page-gap: the page doesn't cover this; the code decides it, or can't. unreachable: the path isn't reached. cant-tell: not enough in the bundle.

path.description: The file, exactly as the bundle names it.

start.description: The first line of the quote, as the bundle numbers it.

end.description: The last line of the quote.

quote.description: The code, word for word, without the line numbers.

suggestedSeverity.description: Required for a stands verdict, and optional for others. Only a suggestion: a person sets severity. blocker: users on the normal path lose data or can't finish. major: a wrong result on the normal path, or blocked on a rare one. minor: wrong on a rare path, or confusing. cosmetic: wording only.

security.description: Whether this finding touches security, such as logins, permissions, or trusting data a browser sent, whatever the verdict. Not a security review, and no grade.

path.description: Needed when touches is true. The file, exactly as the bundle names it.

start.description: The first line of the quote, as the bundle numbers it.

end.description: The last line of the quote.

quote.description: The code, word for word, without the line numbers.
